meta.title: 6 signs you're mentally stronger than you realise

plates.query: Caspar David Friedrich figure standing firm in wind painting
J. M. W. Turner ship holding steady in storm painting

beats.text: Six signs you're mentally stronger than you give yourself credit for.
One. You can feel a hard emotion without letting it drive the car.
Two. You keep going when motivation is long gone. Discipline carries you the rest of the way.
Three. You can be alone without feeling empty. Your own company is enough.
Four. You admit mistakes quickly. It takes strength to say 'I was wrong' and mean it.
Five. You don't need everyone to like you. You'd rather be respected than popular.
Six. You've survived things you once thought would break you — and you're still here, still trying.
Mental strength isn't never struggling. It's refusing to let the struggle have the final word.
